source: Lange & Jansson (2014), A comparison of an explicit and an implicit transient strain formulation for concrete in fire; Table 1 and Fig. 2, printed pp.574–575, reproducing Anderberg & Thelandersson (1976) Bulletin 54
protocol: constant compression applied before heating, 5 C/min, 75x150 mm cylinder with 10 mm central hole; stored at 20 C and 65% RH for 21–26 weeks
stress_basis: reported preload ratio relative to 0.75 times cube strength, as in reproduction
strain_basis: extension-positive longitudinal strain change with initial mechanical strain removed; not isolated transient strain
notes: Manual visual anchors from figure, not raw measurements. Use before rapid strain excursion only; no failure-temperature inference.
K=2.35 reported for this test family, so screening is not independent validation of K.
No specimen-specific modulus, aggregate or instantaneous hot curve available in admitted reproduction; SP modulus scenario is a sensitivity only.
